cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(RZGCS VERSION 1.0.0 LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# Finde Qt
find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Core Gui Qml Quick)

# QML-Module
qt_add_qml_module(RZGCS
    URI RZGCS
    VERSION 1.0
    QML_FILES
        App.qml
        FlightPhaseIndicator.qml
        PreflightView.qml
        ParameterView.qml
        SensorView.qml
        CalibrationView.qml
        MotorTestView.qml
        FlightView.qml
        AngelView.qml
        LicenseView.qml
        SupportView.qml
        SITLView.qml
        StoreView.qml
        KeyManagementView.ui.qml
        KeyManager.qml
        KeyGenerator.qml
        KeyValidator.qml
        KeyVerifier.qml
        KeySigner.qml
        KeyEncryptor.qml
        KeyDecryptor.qml
)

# Python-Bindings
find_package(Python3 COMPONENTS Interpreter Development REQUIRED)
find_package(PySide6 REQUIRED)

# Hauptanwendung
add_executable(rzgcs
    main.py
    backend_bridge.py
)

# Verlinke mit Qt
target_link_libraries(rzgcs PRIVATE
    Qt6::Core
    Qt6::Gui
    Qt6::Qml
    Qt6::Quick
    Python3::Python
    PySide6::Core
    PySide6::Gui
    PySide6::Qml
)

# Installiere
install(TARGETS rzgcs
    RUNTIME DESTINATION bin
)

# Installiere QML-Module
install(DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/RZGCS
    DESTINATION lib/qml
)
